'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Reid Smith DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
